description: This file implements a Tlon channel runtime for the openclaw plugin SDK, including functions for creating HTTP poke APIs, resolving outbound contexts, sending messages/media, probing accounts, and starting gateway accounts. It also exports a setup wizard.

methods.name: createHttpPokeApi
methods.description: Creates an API object for poking a Tlon account via HTTP, including methods for sending and deleting pokes.

methods.name: resolveOutboundContext
methods.description: Resolves and validates the outbound Tlon account context based on configuration and target.

methods.name: resolveReplyId
methods.description: Determines the reply ID to use for message threading.

methods.name: withHttpPokeAccountApi
methods.description: Executes a callback with an authenticated API object for a specific Tlon account, ensuring cleanup afterward.

methods.name: probeTlonAccount
methods.description: Probes a Tlon account to verify connectivity and configuration.

methods.name: startTlonGatewayAccount
methods.description: Starts a Tlon account gateway, setting status and initiating provider monitoring.
